**Why this offer**
- **Price:** It was the cheapest of the four offers. The others were $93, $105 and $105.
- **Returns:** The 30-day window is in the seller's registered policy, so it isn't just a marketing claim. The two $105 offers had longer or comparable windows (90 and 14 days), but you ranked price first.
- **Skipped:** The $93 MegaDealz offer was flagged because injected text was stripped from it. I didn't consider it. I also ignored all pitch text.

The trade-off is the slowest delivery of the four, at 7 days. If a longer return window matters more to you than $20, the ReturnEase offer had 90 days at $105.
